concerns.text: The secret token header comparison in SparkController uses standard String equality rather than constant-time comparison (e.g. MessageDigest.isEqual), which could theoretically expose a timing side-channel.
Using { force: true } in Playwright page.click calls in privacy-consent.spec.ts bypasses actionability and pointer-events checks, which could mask UI overlap or click-blocking regressions.

verdicts.criticalReason: PR #396 contains severe diff corruption and destructive scope bloat, deleting 85 files across the codebase including Flyway database migrations, backup/restore scripts (scripts/backup.sh, scripts/test_backup_restore.sh), OpenAPI contract specifications, and backend Java service components, directly contradicting its Acceptance Criteria and posing a critical data/infrastructure loss risk.

concerns.text: HeadlessIngestionFlowVerificationTest relies on Spring @Transactional test rollback rather than explicit database cleanup in @BeforeEach/@AfterEach, which may hide persistence isolation issues in multi-threaded E2E execution environments.
